name: elon-flow
description: A first-principles engineering operating system for deciding what should exist, proving what is true, building the minimum correct implementation, and improving the mechanism that produces the work.

interface.longDescription: Apply first-principles reasoning, aggressive deletion, governing-constraint analysis, empirical verification, minimal implementation, and recursive production-system improvement to engineering work.
defaultPrompt: Use Elon-Flow on this engineering problem.
Challenge this design from first principles before we build it.
Find the governing constraint and the smallest experiment that can move it.
